scheme_name: Nirman Shramik Auzaar Toolkit Sahayata Yojana
other_conditions: Must be a native of Rajasthan state.
Must be a registered construction worker for at least 3 years.
Purchase of tools/toolkits must be made by the construction worker themselves, and the bill must be attached to the application.
benefits_summary: Reimbursement up to the actual cost of tools/toolkit or ₹2,000, whichever is lower.
